approach: Rewrite land::pr_commits to classify each commit in remote_base..head by content against its sole first parent p. Order: (1) job landing, (2) declared intervention, (3) records-only by fingerprint(c) == fingerprint(p), (4) refuse naming the sha. Job-landing detection mirrors athena-gate's closing_jobs (invariant.rs:225-252) rules exactly: added ('A') path shaped records/jobs/<month>/<id>/<name>, name in the closing set, JobId::parse ok, job.is_request(), path == job.dir()/name. Because invariant.rs is not a listed deliverable and closing_jobs is private, the rules are copied into a small private helper in land.rs with a comment pointing at invariant.rs (athena-core already depends on athena-gate, but exporting would touch an unlisted file). A job is a landing when, in c's tree, candidate.json, verification.json parse, and either (a) the commit adds the fresh trio and outcome.json parses as Landed, or (b) the commit adds outcome-landed.json (Landed) and p holds a blocked outcome.json (the retried/`go` after blocked path). Job id is read from the parsed records and must equal the dir's id. A commit that adds closing records for two or more jobs (D69 squash chain) is refused, naming the sha and the jobs. LandingKind (snake_case enum) is added to athena-data history.rs; LandingCommit gets required `kind`, with job and verification as Option (skipped when None), validated per kind in Landing::validate, deny_unknown_fields kept. gh.rs passes kind through and builds intent job_ids from job_landing entries only.

decisions.choice: Check job landing, then intervention, before the records-only fingerprint test.
decisions.reason: A landing or a records-only intervention would otherwise be mislabelled records_only; the real PR shape expects declared_intervention and job_landing to show.

rejected.why: A pure-records intervention or landing commit would be labelled records_only and lose its meaning.

rejected.option: Special-case the lease commit by subject or path
rejected.why: Violates root-cause: the fault is trailer attribution; classification must come from content.

decisions.choice: Copy closing_jobs' path rules into land.rs with a comment citing invariant.rs:225-252, and add the outcome-landed.json-after-blocked case.
decisions.reason: invariant.rs is not a listed deliverable and the function is private; copying exactly (is_request, path == job.dir()/name, JobId::parse) keeps the two aligned, and the blocked-then-go path (run.rs, chain.rs treat both outcome names as landed) is a valid PR shape.

rejected.why: Touches an unlisted governance-adjacent file; a one-time copy with a pointer comment is smaller.
Refuses a valid PR whose job landed after a blocked outcome.

decisions.choice: A commit closing more than one job is refused with an error naming the sha and every job; documented in records-history.md 5.3 and tested.
decisions.reason: LandingCommit carries a single job; attributing a chain to one job would be a guess. Refusing is strict and honest; a squash chain can be landed per job.

rejected.option: Attribute to the last job of the chain
rejected.why: Needs fingerprint-chain reasoning and silently drops attribution of the others.

decisions.choice: job and verification are Option with skip_serializing_if, required only for job_landing and forbidden for the other kinds; no intervention id field.
decisions.reason: Only job landings have a job and verification; per-kind validation keeps strictness.

rejected.why: Criterion 3 requires a missing kind be rejected.

decisions.choice: No code migration; the producer states in its change description whether landings without kind can exist and, if they can, names a one-time records-branch rewrite (add kind=job_landing) as a required follow-up before the next land.
decisions.reason: Existing/records_under in gh.rs parses every stored landing, so an unmigrated landing would fail every later land. Every landing since 29fdd4c failed in pr_commits, so landings written after that point cannot exist; only landings from earlier trailer-based runs might, and each carries job+verification, so the rewrite is mechanical.

rejected.why: Loosens strictness for the record type.

steps: Grep for athena.landing/1 in tests, fixtures and docs; decide and note whether kind-less landings can exist (none written since 29fdd4c).

In land.rs change PrCommit to {sha, tree, kind, job: Option<JobId>}; write classify_commit using git.parents, git.diff_tree, git.show_file, AnyRecord::parse, the copied closing-path rules, and fingerprint(c,p) vs fingerprint(p,p); remove trailer handling; refuse root commits and multi-job commits.

risks.risk: A valid landing shape is missed (e.g. outcome-landed.json after blocked).
risks.mitigation: Mirror closing_jobs and the retried rule; a dedicated test covers the blocked-then-landed commit.

risks.risk: Copied path rules drift from invariant.rs.
risks.mitigation: Comment pointing to invariant.rs:225-252; tests use the same shapes.

risks.risk: Root or merge commits have no single first parent.
risks.mitigation: Refuse them with an error naming the sha.

risks.risk: Unmigrated stored landings break every later land.
risks.mitigation: State the finding in the change description and name the one-time rewrite as a required follow-up; no loosening of serde.
Compiler plus the gh landing test catch every use.

demonstrations.method: Unit test in land.rs builds a real temp git repo with no Athena-Job trailers: base, reading, dispatch, introspection, lease (records-only x4), an intervention-record commit, then a commit adding candidate/verification/outcome(Landed) plus a governed change.
demonstrations.observes: pr_commits returns kinds [records_only x4, declared_intervention, job_landing] in order; the last carries the job id and verification id read from the records. A sibling test, landing_after_a_blocked_outcome_is_a_job_landing, has a final commit that adds only outcome-landed.json over a parent with a blocked outcome and sees job_landing.
demonstrations.fails_without: Under the trailer rule the first untrailed commit aborts pr_commits; a classifier that mislabels the intervention or landing, or misses outcome-landed.json, fails the kind assertions.

demonstrations.method: land.rs test adds a commit changing a governed file with no intervention or closing records; a gh.rs test runs the landing flow on that range with the fake records sink and asserts the sink holds nothing.
demonstrations.observes: Err message contains the commit sha and 'governed content'; the sink has no intent or landing record. A further test (a_commit_closing_two_jobs_is_refused) checks the squash-chain refusal names the sha and both jobs.
demonstrations.fails_without: Without the refusal branch the commit is accepted or an unrelated trailer error fires, so the sha/wording assertion fails; without ordering of pr_commits before writes, the sink would hold records.

demonstrations.method: history.rs tests parse landing JSON with kind "bogus", no kind, an extra field, and validate a job_landing with job None and with verification None, plus a records_only carrying a job.
demonstrations.observes: Each invalid case errors (Parse or validation); a valid entry of each kind passes.
demonstrations.fails_without: A defaulted kind would let the missing-kind parse succeed; without per-kind validate an incomplete job_landing would pass.

demonstrations.method: Inspect pr_commits and its helpers in land.rs: no git.trailers call or Athena-Job read; the old trailer-count tests are removed and replaced by classification tests, which run.
demonstrations.observes: Classification tests pass and git diff of land.rs shows the trailer code and old tests removed.
demonstrations.fails_without: If trailer reading remained, the trailer-free PR test would fail.

demonstrations.method: The history.rs round-trip test serializes a Landing with one entry per kind and parses it back; the gh.rs landing test asserts the recorded LandingCommit has kind JobLanding.
demonstrations.observes: Parsed record equals the original; the gh landing test passes with kind passed through.
demonstrations.fails_without: If gh.rs did not pass kind it would not compile; if serde dropped kind the round trip would differ.

demonstrations.method: Run the three checks across the workspace.
demonstrations.observes: Clippy is clean; cargo fmt --all --check and cargo test --locked also pass, including gate landing_tests, reconcile and cli reconcile.
demonstrations.fails_without: Any warning, format drift or broken existing test shows.

demonstrations.method: Inspect the diff for a CHANGELOG entry and the updated records-history.md 5.3 (Which commits bullet, failure-path table row, squash-chain refusal note).
demonstrations.observes: Both files changed and describe content classification instead of the Athena-Job trailer rule.
